title: Rivergate and Summit
author: J. M. Sandoval
blurb: Sebastian Thornbury, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
